# Rudy Monga

> Senior full-stack engineer at Stan, previously Co-Founder & CTO of VantEdge, host of Not A Minimum Viable Podcast. Builder-first identity, working across creator-facing product, enterprise AI infrastructure, and podcast media. Based in Toronto.

Tagline: Building Things That Compound.

Full name: Rudraksh (Rudy) Monga. Also known as: whyismynamerudy.

## Current work

- Stan (Aug 2026 → present): Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer. Building Stanley, an AI assistant that helps creators draft, schedule, and publish social posts through chat. I work on making it something people keep coming back to, and finding ways to make the AI behind it faster and less expensive to run. I also help take new product ideas from early experiments to their first customers.
- Not A Minimum Viable Podcast (2025 → present): Host and producer. 18 episodes as of August 2026, Season 2 in progress. Topic-focused conversations with post-PMF operators about how tech companies actually get built, scaled, and sold.

## Past work

- VantEdge (2025): Co-Founder & CTO. The platform for building AI-native internal applications. University of Toronto AI/ML spinout.

- Amazon Web Services (May–Aug 2025): Software Engineer Intern, anomaly detection.
- University of Toronto (Jan–Apr 2025): Software Engineer, GPU Profiling Tools. Built tools to find performance bottlenecks in ML training and inference.
- Intact Insurance (2023–2024): Infrastructure Operations. Delivered 150% parallel build capacity and 97% release cycle acceleration.
- University of Toronto (2022–2024): ML research under Prof. Ashton Anderson on RAG for knowledge-graph query answering.
- Speech Classification Paper (April 2020): Published research applying Particle Swarm Optimization to speech classification.

## Notable ships

- [Visight](https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7402760209376673792/): F1 sponsor exposure computer vision project. Fine-tuned YOLOv8, TensorRT quantization, detects 86 brands frame-by-frame. Writeup earned 650K+ views and 9.5K reactions on LinkedIn.
- [Claude Folder Upload Helper](https://github.com/whyismynamerudy/claude-folder-upload): Chrome extension enabling folder uploads to Claude projects. 2,000+ daily active users, actively used across the developer community.
